experiment: B: channel-capacity experiment (W x frozen/LoRA + controls + text baseline)

setup.backbone: SD1.5 fp16, UNet frozen unless LoRA
setup.data: CelebA via flwrlabs/celeba, 6 identities x 4 refs/5 targets, 24 training images
setup.eval: 2 held-out identities x 4 scenes (CLIP-I vs 3 other real photos of that identity), 512x512, DDIM 20 steps, cfg 7.5
setup.lora: rank 8, alpha 16, cross-attn (attn2) q/k/v/out only, 44758208 params, fp32 adapters
setup.readout: Head2(1280->768 GELU -> mean pool over 64 tokens -> MLP -> W x 768 context tokens)
setup.note: CLIP-I scale: same image 1.0, different person ~0.52 on this metric

text_baseline.desc: one human-written sentence per identity appended to the scene prompt

separability.note: chance = 0.50; channel carries essentially no identity signal

verdict.H9: triggered - LoRA + W=128 (0.4484) does not beat text baseline (0.5131); memory injection declared dead at this compute tier
verdict.bandwidth: not the constraint: 8 -> 128 tokens monotonically hurts (-0.026 frozen, -0.021 lora)
verdict.readout_use: real - zero = +0.0073, real - rand = +0.0118: the readout contributes almost nothing
verdict.prompt_adherence: text baseline highest CLIP-T 0.3486; memory arms 0.29-0.31
